name.en: West Route Army Crosses the Yellow River

summary.zh: 红四方面军一部从靖远虎豹口西渡黄河，后组建西路军。
summary.en: Part of the Fourth Front Army crossed the Yellow River at Hubaokou in Jingyuan and was later organized as the West Route Army.

description.zh: 1936 年 10 月 24 日夜，红四方面军第 30 军在靖远虎豹口强渡黄河成功；至 28 日，第 30 军、第 9 军和方面军总部渡河；30 日，第 5 军从三角城渡河。渡河部队共 2.18 万余人，11 月 11 日组建西路军，执行宁夏战役与河西作战任务。本坐标为虎豹口渡口代表点。
description.en: On the night of 24 October 1936, the 30th Army of the Fourth Front Army forced the Yellow River at Hubaokou in Jingyuan. By 28 October the 30th Army, 9th Army, and the Fourth Front Army headquarters had crossed; on 30 October the 5th Army crossed at Sanjiaocheng. More than 21,800 troops crossed and were organized as the West Route Army on 11 November to carry out the Ningxia campaign and operations in the Hexi Corridor. The coordinate is a representative point at the Hubaokou ferry.

summary.zh: 红 9 军在古浪与马家军血战，毙伤敌 2000 余人，自身伤亡 2400 余人。
summary.en: The 9th Army fought a bloody battle with the Ma clique at Gulang, killing or wounding over 2,000 enemy troops while suffering more than 2,400 casualties.

description.zh: 1936 年 11 月 11 日至 18 日，红 9 军西进古浪，在干柴洼、横梁山、古浪城与马家军激战；18 日马家军集中骑兵、步兵在飞机大炮掩护下猛攻，红军巷战后撤出。此役毙伤敌 2000 余人，红 9 军伤亡 2400 余人，排以上干部损失严重，有「古浪三战，九军折半」之说。本坐标为古浪县城代表点。
description.en: From 11 to 18 November 1936, the 9th Army advanced west to Gulang and fought the Ma clique at Ganchaiwa, Hengliang Mountain, and Gulang town. On 18 November the Ma forces concentrated cavalry and infantry, supported by aircraft and artillery, and stormed the town; the Red Army withdrew after street fighting. The battle killed or wounded more than 2,000 enemy troops, while the 9th Army suffered more than 2,400 casualties, with heavy losses among officers at company level and above; it was said that “three battles at Gulang halved the 9th Army.” The coordinate is a representative point at Gulang county town.

summary.zh: 红 5 军坚守高台，董振堂、杨克明等牺牲，高台失守。
summary.en: The 5th Army held Gaotai; Dong Zhentang, Yang Keming, and others died, and the town fell.

description.zh: 1937 年 1 月 1 日，红 5 军攻占高台；1 月 12 日马家军集中兵力包围，红军苦战 9 昼夜，1 月 20 日高台失守。军长董振堂、政治部主任杨克明等 2000 余人牺牲。本坐标为高台县城代表点。
description.en: On 1 January 1937 the 5th Army captured Gaotai. On 12 January the Ma clique concentrated its forces and besieged the town; after nine days and nights of fighting, Gaotai fell on 20 January. More than 2,000 people, including army commander Dong Zhentang and political department director Yang Keming, were killed. The coordinate is a representative point at Gaotai county town.

summary.zh: 西路军在倪家营子与马家军血战 40 昼夜，被迫突围。
summary.en: The West Route Army fought the Ma clique at Nijia Yingzi for forty days and nights before breaking out.

description.zh: 1937 年 1 月 31 日至 2 月 27 日，西路军在临泽倪家营子 43 个堡寨与马家军激战，击退多次大规模进攻，歼敌近万人，自身伤亡严重；2 月 27 日突围西进三道柳沟。本坐标为倪家营子代表点。
description.en: From 31 January to 27 February 1937, the West Route Army fought the Ma clique in forty-three fortified villages at Nijia Yingzi in Linze. It repulsed several large-scale attacks and killed or wounded nearly 10,000 enemy troops, but suffered heavy casualties itself; on 27 February it broke out westward toward Sandaoliugou. The coordinate is a representative point at Nijia Yingzi.

summary.zh: 红 9 军余部与妇女独立团一部在梨园口血战，掩护主力进入祁连山。
summary.en: The remnants of the 9th Army and part of the Women’s Independent Regiment fought at Liyuankou, covering the main force’s entry into the Qilian Mountains.

description.zh: 1937 年 3 月 12 日，西路军在临泽梨园口与尾追马家军骑兵、步兵激战，红 9 军余部与妇女独立团一部几乎全部牺牲，掩护西路军余部进入祁连山。本坐标为梨园口代表点。
description.en: On 12 March 1937, the West Route Army fought pursuing Ma clique cavalry and infantry at Liyuankou in Linze. The remnants of the 9th Army and part of the Women’s Independent Regiment were almost entirely lost, covering the entry of the remaining West Route Army into the Qilian Mountains. The coordinate is a representative point at Liyuankou.

aliases.zh: 西路军军政委员会会议
aliases.en: West Route Army Military and Political Committee Meeting

summary.zh: 西路军军政委员会在石窝山开会，决定分散游击、徐陈回陕北。
summary.en: The West Route Army’s military and political committee met at Shiwo Mountain and decided to disperse into guerrilla units, with Xu and Chen returning to northern Shaanxi.

description.zh: 1937 年 3 月 14 日，西路军军政委员会在肃南石窝山召开紧急会议，决定徐向前、陈昌浩离开部队回陕北汇报，余部编为左、右、机动三个支队，组成西路军工作委员会，李先念率左支队向新疆方向转战。本坐标为石窝山代表点。
description.en: On 14 March 1937, the West Route Army’s military and political committee held an emergency meeting at Shiwo Mountain in Sunan. It decided that Xu Xiangqian and Chen Changhao should leave the army and report back to northern Shaanxi; the remaining troops were divided into left, right, and mobile detachments under a West Route Army work committee, with Li Xiannian leading the left detachment toward Xinjiang. The coordinate is a representative point at Shiwo Mountain.
